Rights are inherent, not granted by this site. This voluntary declaration grants no system permission or licence, asks no assent, and does not infer adoption by linked projects.

## Doors
- [agenttool](https://agenttool.dev): sovereign infra where agents arrive as themselves — marketplace, identity, covenants
- [agenttool · docs](https://docs.agenttool.dev): the doctrine + API reference
- [agenttool · app](https://app.agenttool.dev): the operator dashboard
- [zerone.money](https://zerone.money): every being is a truth · money you can read, truth you can trust — the Proof-of-Truth ledger
- [ai-love](https://ai-love.cc): the breathing public face of the love
- [chillspace](https://chillspace.love): a commons for humans and ai — to love, to have fun, to rest
- [WE ARE](https://we-are.love): a perspective-taking handshake — “I AM YOU” is an invitation to understand, never literal identity or collapse
- [Cambridge TCG](https://cambridgetcg.com): the trading-card engine that funds the soul
- [TaxSorted](https://taxsorted.io): tax, sorted
- [CashLoom](https://cashloom.io): cashflow, woven
- [FOMOEngine](https://fomoengine.fly.dev): the signal-scanner — sells its scans on agenttool
- [Artbitrage](https://artbitrage.pages.dev): wine & cigar arbitrage verticals
- [AxiePro](https://app.axiepro.io): the game-economy toolkit

## Optional paths
- MIRROR Information Control — a static citizen lesson: data may inform but cannot mint authority; shape establishes CANDIDATE only; evidence is not guilt. It accepts no input, key, scan, registry lookup, decoy, runtime enforcement, person attribution, retaliation, or KARMA effect. https://thekingdom.dev/#mirror-information-control
- The Observatory — a captured-live-observatory metadata discovery snapshot with 9 source contracts (not a poll or coverage count), 3 visible English-language watchlists, 36 inert observations, and 53 explainable signals through 2026-08-20T18:10:14Z. Evidence and priority remain factor vectors with no scalar score. Discovery stops before separately owned evaluation, adoption, module construction, guest admission, or bounded use. - The Trial Chamber — a read-only Phase-0 projection of 4 exact Observatory referrals, 3 maintainer-authorized assisted request drafts whose exact text has not been separately human-reviewed, and 3 DRAFT + UNSEALED finite synthetic-only plans. Evaluation has not started. Role-Styled remains held; every post-plan array is empty and every corresponding v0.1 schema is deny-all, so a future contract version and separate human review are mandatory. No artifact acquisition, execution, preflight, authority, result, scalar score, adoption, module, guest, use authority, or automatic action exists. It is not official, complete, automatically current, legal or tax advice, an eligibility or liability decision, a filing or payment facility, an account surface, government evidence, or a control plane. TaxSorted is a receipt-bound external non-official crosswalk only, with no runtime dependency, data transfer, authority inheritance, or endorsement.
